\name{chemi_amos_batch}
\alias{chemi_amos_batch}
\title{Generates an Excel workbook which lists all records in the database that contain a given set of DTXSIDs.}
\usage{
chemi_amos_batch(
  additional_record_info = NULL,
  always_download_file = NULL,
  base_url = NULL,
  ids = NULL,
  include_classyfire = NULL,
  include_external_links = NULL,
  include_functional_uses = NULL,
  include_source_counts = NULL,
  methodologies = NULL,
  record_types = NULL
)
}
\arguments{
\item{additional_record_info}{additional_record_info}

\item{always_download_file}{always_download_file}

\item{base_url}{base_url}

\item{ids}{ids}

\item{include_classyfire}{include_classyfire}

\item{include_external_links}{include_external_links}

\item{include_functional_uses}{include_functional_uses}

\item{include_source_counts}{include_source_counts}

\item{methodologies}{methodologies}

\item{record_types}{record_types}
}
\value{
Raw Excel workbook bytes. Errors retain typed HTTP or transport conditions.
}
